title: The final scout
base_prompt:
Fully animated cinematic stylized-realistic 3D CGI feature-film shot, continuous motion, expressive character animation and acting, believable fur and cloth simulation, detailed wet stone and metal, dynamic ocean, rain, spray, steam and sparks, cinematic lighting, anamorphic 16:9 widescreen, 24 fps.
Setting: the narrow curved iron-and-stone catwalk with a rusted iron railing circling the brass lantern room at the top of a weathered cliffside stone lighthouse, high above a rocky ocean and sea spray. Time and weather: darkening storm at dusk, cold slate-blue light, rain, lightning on the horizon.
Characters (keep exactly on-model): Tomkin, a compact, stout ginger-and-white tabby cat walking upright, wearing a thick ribbed grey wool sock folded over his ears like a baker's toque, a lavender silk boxer-shorts cape fastened at the neck with a brass safety pin, wielding a bent stainless-steel soup ladle like a rapier and carrying a yellow plastic butter tub; expressive, brave and comically self-important; small gunmetal-grey scout drones the size of seagulls, each with a single crimson optical visor and whirring rotors.
Camera: low angle on Tomkin leaping at the final scout; one continuous shot, no cuts.
Action: Tomkin leaps from the ledge back onto the catwalk and whacks the final scout's glowing power latch with his ladle; the latch flips open, the drone powers down and drops onto the grating.
No dialogue.
Sound: ladle whack, latch click, power-down whine, metal clatter.
Audio: realistic sound effects and ambience only; spoken dialogue only as written above; no background music; no narrator.
extension_prompt:
